{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload the data to be sure
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Re-check missing values explicitly for 'converted'
print('Missing values in converted:')
print(df['converted'].isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicate order_id
print('\nDuplicate order_id count:')
print(df['order_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check if any customer_segment has only one order or is extremely skewed
print('\nValue counts for customer_segment:')
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().round(4)
print('\nConversion rate by segment:')
print(conversion_rate)

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rate.max()

print(f'\nBest segment: {best_segment} with conversion rate {best_rate}')"}
